title: A keepNext block that cannot keep and cannot split sends the nearest splittable block's tail ahead of it; a chain that would fit a fresh page still splits
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-10-28), 4 pages: Letter 1440 margins, Arial 12 exact 240 (54 lines), widow control on. p1 = 43 filler + A lines 1-2 (baselines 597.6/609.6), p2 = A lines 3-4 + B + C + anchor (81.6 .. 189.6); p3 = 48 filler + heading + body lines 1-4 (657.6 .. 705.6), p4 = body lines 5-6 + anchor2 (81.6 .. 117.6)

cases.note: A (4 lines) opens on page 1: the chain is not moved whole
B (3 lines, keepLines) follows A's tail on page 2
C (3 lines, atomic under widow control) cannot keep the anchor on page 1
L720: heading stays on page 3 although heading + body + anchor would fit a fresh page
body splits 4 + 2 at the page bottom
anchor2 opens page 4 behind the body's last two lines
